# `usage_threshold`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

An allowance threshold (80% or 100%) reached by a line in a plan period: one row is one event, once per product, period and allowance. The notifications slice reads it.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `period_start` | `date` | no |  | First date of the funded interval (plan period) the usage was counted in. |
| `allowance` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `threshold` | `smallint` | no |  |  |
| `period_end` | `date` | no |  |  |
| `usage_record_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `used` | `bigint` | no |  | Period usage when the threshold was reached, in the usage_record unit. |
| `included` | `bigint` | no |  | The allowance at that time in the same unit (MB x 1048576 bytes, minutes x 60 seconds, messages), add-ons included. |
| `reached_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
